title: GamingLANDR.com
tagline: Cosmonaut-themed intelligence hub aggregating gaming leaks and rumors across Twitter, Bluesky, and Reddit.
overview: GamingLANDR.com is an upcoming space/cosmonaut-themed intelligence hub tracking and cross-verifying gaming industry leaks and rumors. It synthesizes real-time chatter and breaking reports from X (Twitter), the AT Protocol (Bluesky), and r/GamingLeaksAndRumours into a unified radar feed with credibility scoring and spoiler controls.
architectureOverview: Multi-stream event listeners poll and webhook-subscribe to Bluesky, Twitter/X firehoses, and Reddit feeds. Ingested claims are normalized, deduplicated via semantic vector similarity, and relayed to cosmonaut HUD clients over WebSockets.

takeaways.challenge: Aggregating unformatted rumor threads across multiple disparate social APIs with varying rate limits.
takeaways.solution: Architected an edge queue consumer with priority backoff and automatic cross-platform claim deduplication.

takeaways.challenge: Filtering signal from noise while preserving chronological breaking alerts.
takeaways.solution: Designed a community-weighted veracity rating system alongside spoiler tagging and provenance chain inspection.

title: Vanguard Flags
tagline: Zero-latency feature flag evaluation engine and real-time telemetry control plane.
overview: Vanguard Flags enables engineering teams to decouple deployment from release using deterministic percentage rollouts, cohort targeting rules, and instant kill-switches synchronized globally.
architectureOverview: Rule definitions are compiled into compact JSON ASTs in the control plane, replicated to Redis edge caches, and streamed to connected SDK clients over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

takeaways.challenge: Inconsistent bucketing across web and backend SDKs during gradual percentage rollouts.
takeaways.solution: Standardized on a unified MurmurHash3 specification with shared cross-language conformance test vectors.

takeaways.challenge: Stale flag rules when network connectivity drops between application nodes and the control plane.
takeaways.solution: Built a local disk-backed fallback snapshot store with exponential backoff reconnection on SSE streams.
